Package com.esignal.jstandard.managers

Core ResourceManager interfaces that should be used to retrieve the data from eSignal servers.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AnalyticsManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the Analytics data.
    AuthenticationManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide resources related to authentication of given user.
    ContentManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the Content data.
    HistoryManager
    The HistoryManager allows users to request Historical Bars for the eSignal symbols.
    MarketDepthManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide resources of MarketDepth records.
    NewsManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the News Headlines and Stories.
    ProxyManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the Content and Analytics data.
    QuoteManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide resources of Quotes.
    ResourceManager
    This is the base interface of any ResourceManager.
    TickHistoryManager
    The TickHistoryManager allows users to request Historical Tick and Intraday Bar data for eSignal symbols.
    TriggeredQuoteEventManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide resources of Triggered Quotes.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AbstractResourceManager
    Purpose of this abstract class is to provide a base implementation of ResourceManager.
    ResourceManagerFactory
    Purpose of this abstract factory is to create different resource managers of available implementations.
    UsernameInfo
    This object is used for returning the username, password and returnCode back to the user when they call the ResourceManagerFactory.acquireUsername(com.esignal.jstandard.beans.ConnectionSettings) method.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    ResourceManagerFactory.IMPLEMENTATION
    This enum provides all the available IMPLEMENTATION of the ResourceManager.

Package com.esignal.jstandard.managers Description

Core ResourceManager interfaces that should be used to retrieve the data from eSignal servers.

Read individual manager interface documentation for its usage.
